assumptions: RDKit's descriptors and medchem's rule and alert definitions.
bio.jane/contract.question: How does each structure of this library fare against these rules and alerts?

description: Screen every structure of a library at once against drug-likeness rules and structural-alert catalogs, as the library grid does, and bin one rule property across it, split at the bound of a chosen rule. Returns, per 0-based structure, the rules it breaks and the alerts it trips, and the binned distribution with how many structures fall within the bound.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alert_sets.description: which structural-alert catalogs to screen against. Empty screens nothing.

molecules.description: the library: one SMILES or molfile per entry.

property.description: the rule property to bin, at the value the rules judged. Values: mw (Monoisotopic mass), clogp (cLogP (Crippen)), hbd (H-bond donors), hba (H-bond acceptors), lipinskiHbd (Lipinski donors (NH + OH)), lipinskiHba (Lipinski acceptors (N + O)), hbonds (Donors + acceptors), tpsa (TPSA (N and O only)), rotatableBonds (Rotatable bonds), rings (Rings), heavyAtoms (Heavy atoms), numAtoms (Atoms in the graph), molarRefractivity (Molar refractivity (Crippen)), averageMw (Molecular weight (average)), totalAtoms (Atoms, hydrogens included), formalCharge (Net formal charge).

rules.description: which drug-likeness rules to screen, by id. Every rule by default.

split_rule.description: the rule whose bound on that property splits each bar; the first screened rule bounding it by default. Values: rule_of_five (Lipinski rule of five), rule_of_five_beyond (Beyond rule of five), rule_of_four (Rule of four (PPI inhibitors)), rule_of_three (Rule of three (fragments)), rule_of_three_extended (Rule of three, extended), rule_of_two (Rule of two (building blocks)), rule_of_ghose (Ghose filter), rule_of_veber (Veber filter), rule_of_reos (REOS), rule_of_chemaxon_druglikeness (ChemAxon drug-likeness), rule_of_egan (Egan filter), rule_of_pfizer_3_75 (Pfizer 3/75), rule_of_gsk_4_400 (GSK 4/400), rule_of_oprea (Oprea lead-likeness), rule_of_xu (Xu drug-like index), rule_of_cns (CNS penetration), rule_of_respiratory (Respiratory (inhaled/nasal)), rule_of_five_paper (Lipinski rule of five (paper: average MW)), rule_of_ghose_paper (Ghose filter (paper: all atoms, average MW)), rule_of_reos_paper (REOS (paper: net charge bounded, average MW)).

name: screen_molecule_library

distribution.description: the bins (lo, hi, within, outside), the bounds on the property and the split

rows.description: per structure: 0-based index, canonical SMILES, rules broken, alerts tripped

summary.description: how many structures pass clean, and how many fall within the split bound
